minimumCauses: The initiating planning defect was the missing bounded corrective retry after deterministic WorkGraph rejection; generic runTask also continued into validation and Repairer recovery after pre-execution planning had failed.
npm-check was a separate candidate-workspace dependency setup failure. Exact stdout proves TypeScript could not resolve project modules and Node declarations; build/tests were not reached.

No WorkGraph meant no ParticipantPlan/ExecutionBlueprint, Implementer ChangeSet, or CandidateImpact request. Candidate assurance, assertions, EvidenceBundle, AcceptanceOracle, and ObjectiveCompletion were downstream absent/blocked states, not independent bugs.
GitHub project policy was disabled and correctly resolved to an empty external-effect allowlist. Delivery finalization was not reached after acceptance had already failed.
Open stage statuses at terminalization were a separate observability defect and have now been repaired for future operations.
